headline: Orphaned raccoons train for wild release in ‘boot camp’
summary: Woodside Wildlife Rescue is teaching young raccoons to forage, climb and avoid traps before release.
script: Orphaned raccoons are getting a wildlife boot camp before release. Woodside Wildlife Rescue teaches the young animals to forage, climb, swim and avoid traps, so they can return to the wild without relying on people.
imageAlt: A young raccoon in wildlife rehabilitation.
imageAltTwo: A rescued animal photographed by Woodside Wildlife Rescue.
